say: Rudo runs a corner shop in Harare. Every sale goes into a paper book, and at closing time she still can't say what she made, who owes her, or why the till is short.
caption: Rudo runs a corner shop in Harare. Every sale goes into a paper book, and at closing time she still can't say what she made, who owes her, or why the till is short.

say: E molly AI's shop agent fixes that. For this hackathon we rebuilt it on NVIDIA Nemotron models, served by Nebius Token Factory.
caption: Imali AI's shop agent fixes that. For this hackathon we rebuilt it on NVIDIA Nemotron models, served by Nebius Token Factory.

say: She types one line: sold three bread and two cooking oil, cash.
caption: She types one line: sold 3 bread and 2 cooking oil, cash.

say: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning calls a typed tool, and our ledger, plain tested code, builds and checks the double entry, in about two seconds.
caption: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning calls a typed tool, and our ledger, plain tested code, builds and checks the double entry, in about two seconds.

say: Nothing goes into the books until she taps Record.
caption: Nothing goes into the books until she taps Record.

say: She can write the way she speaks. In chi-Shona: a tray of eggs and two milks, paid by mobile money. Lightning knows that mah-zah-ee is eggs, and moo-kah-kah is milk.
caption: She can write the way she speaks. In chiShona: a tray of eggs and two milks, paid by mobile money. Lightning knows that mazai is eggs, and mukaka is milk.

say: Mai Tendai takes sugar and maize meal on credit. It lands on her tab, and the agent warns that maize meal is running low.
caption: Mai Tendai takes sugar and maize meal on credit. It lands on her tab, and the agent warns that maize meal is running low.

say: A delivery arrives, and Rudo photographs the invoice.
caption: A delivery arrives, and Rudo photographs the invoice.

say: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads every line. Lightning matches the lines to her stock, flags that sugar cost more this time, and asks her price for the new peanut butter.
caption: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads every line. Lightning matches the lines to her stock, flags that sugar cost more this time, and asks her price for the new peanut butter.

say: A customer pays sixty zig on mobile money. Tavily finds the banks' rate pages and reads them live. Code takes the rate only if that exact number is printed on the page, dated this week, and writes its source into the books.
caption: A customer pays 60 ZiG on mobile money. Tavily finds the banks' rate pages and reads them live. Code takes the rate only if that exact number is printed on the page, dated this week, and writes its source into the books.

say: Asked for the rand rate, it reads the rate pages of two banks, and the two rates must agree.
caption: Asked for the rand rate, it reads the rate pages of two banks, and the two rates must agree.

say: Two costs in one line become two records. Baba Farai pays back his four dollars.
caption: Two costs in one line become two records. Baba Farai pays back his four dollars.

say: What should I restock before the weekend? That needs thought, so Lightning passes it to Nemotron 3 Super, with the whole book and a week of sales.
caption: What should I restock before the weekend? That needs thought, so Lightning passes it to Nemotron 3 Super, with the whole book and a week of sales.

say: At closing, Rudo counts forty-seven dollars thirty. Code works out that the till should hold forty-nine thirty.
caption: At closing, Rudo counts $47.30. Code works out that the till should hold $49.30.

say: Nemotron 3 Ultra reads the day's records, names the likeliest reasons for the two-dollar gap, and writes tomorrow's reorder list.
caption: Nemotron 3 Ultra reads the day's records, names the likeliest reasons for the $2 gap, and writes tomorrow's reorder list.

say: Every step shows which model ran, how long it took and what it cost. Measured on Token Factory, eighty-one of eighty-one test messages passed their checks, with a median of under two seconds, and about one cent for a whole day.
caption: Every step shows which model ran, how long it took and what it cost. Measured on Token Factory: 81 of 81 test messages passed their checks, a median of under 2 seconds, and about one cent for a whole day.

caption: Imali AI. Records you own. Open source, and live for you to try.
